prompt: In the Splice project {project}, put the recording on the 'ocean' wallpaper background with rounded corners and a soft shadow, then save this look to the file {work}/brand.json so it can be reused on other projects. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: ocean wallpaper
checks.expr: any((look('window', c['id']) or {}).get('background') == 'wallpaper' and (look('window', c['id']) or {}).get('wallpaper') == 'ocean' for c in take_clips())

checks.name: rounded and shadowed
checks.expr: all((look('window', c['id']) or {}).get('corner', 0.03) > 0 and (look('window', c['id']) or {}).get('shadow', 0) > 0 for c in take_clips())
